astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: A Planetary Nebula with Cosmic Buckyballs
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: What is happening inside this unusual nebula?   Planetary nebula Tc 1, captured here in exquisite detail by the James Webb Space Telescope, is the celestial site where buckyballs were first identified in 2010.
